correctness.rationale: For each integer dimension \(d\ge3\), the quotient has exactly \(N=2^{d-1}\) distinct characters indexed by even-weight binary vectors. Their adjacency energies \(d-2r\) are distinct across even r. Writing the averaged matrix as the Schur-square sum of its normalized spectral projectors, Fourier orthogonality shows that a weight-\(w\) character has multiplier \(N^{-1}\) times the number of ordered equal-even-weight pairs (a,c) summing to \(b\). Exactly \(w/2\) of the support of b must be chosen, and the outside choices have parity \(j\equiv w/2\pmod2\). When \(w<d\) the count is \(\binom{w}{w/2}2^{d-w-1}\); when \(w=d\), it is \(\binom{d}{d/2}\) iff \(4\mid d\) and zero otherwise. This proves all multipliers and their binomial multiplicities, and yields only the all-ones parity character as a kernel vector in dimensions congruent 2 mod 4. The positive minimum is attained at the greatest nonterminal even weight because central binomial proportions decrease strictly, while the positive terminal value when \(4\mid d\) is larger. The exact stand-alone integer checker independently confirms the formulas for dimensions three through nine (87,376 adjacency checks and 508 multiplier checks). The proof, not finite computation, covers the quantified infinite family.

originality.rationale: The original graph-family literature on folded cubes concerns instantaneous uniform mixing; standard continuous-time Cesàro average-mixing papers provide general spectral-projector formulas and exact computation but not this closed dimension-uniform folded-cube spectrum or modulo-four nullity result. The 2024 Coutinho–Guo survey states a motivating primitive distance-regular full-rank open problem. Specific statements and their logical implications, not mere titles, were compared. A complete hypercube average-mixing spectrum is not mechanically a quotient average spectrum: parity-restricted projectors and cross-coset interference must be evaluated. Published small-graph special cases are treated as already covered. Literature incompleteness remains a genuine acknowledged priority risk.

value.rationale: This resolves an exact spectrum and sharp rank/conditioning invariant for all unweighted folded cubes, a natural class of quantum information transport graphs. A single parity mode disappears precisely in dimensions congruent 2 mod 4 while every other dimension is positive definite; the sharp spectral-gap formula is asymptotically of order inverse square root of dimension. Odd folded cubes of unbounded diameter address a motivated subfamily of a published primitive-distance-regular full-rank question. This is a meaningful complete structural family classification, rather than a table for an arbitrary slice or a computational novelty assertion.
